meta.scope: OpenAlex 标记为 journal、有 ISSN、最近出版年不早于 2023、累计索引作品至少 100 条的候选记录；按 ISSN 去重。
meta.coverageNote: 70,419 条跨学科期刊候选；各指标的覆盖率分别披露。新刊、小刊、缺少 ISSN 或近期索引记录的期刊可能未纳入。不是征稿白名单。
meta.countDefinition: 年度数量为 OpenAlex 当前快照预计算的索引作品数，可能包含评论、勘误、社论等，并受索引延迟与来源归并影响；不是出版社官方发文量、JIF 分母、投稿量或录用量。
meta.topicDefinition: 学科与主题来自 OpenAlex 自动分类，不是 JCR 学科或中科院分区。
meta.indexingDefinition: listedIn 为 OpenAlex 转录的外部名单成员关系；来源名单名称、维护者和版次见 sourceLists。缺失成员关系不等于未收录。
meta.apcDefinition: APC 为 OpenAlex 元数据中记录的目录价格；币种、税费、减免、文章类型和报价年份需向出版社复核，缺失值不等于免费。
meta.activityDefinition: 最近存在索引记录不保证该刊仍然征稿；投稿前核对出版社官网、刊名变更及收录状态。

jif.provider: Nikolaev Institute of Inorganic Chemistry, publicly hosted JCR table
jif.note: 表头 JIF 2026/JIF 2025 使用发布年份；已与出版社标明的 2025/2024 指标年交叉核对。空值及 <0.1 原样保留。属机构公开转录，需以 Clarivate 与出版社为最终核验依据。

jcr.note: 按期刊、学科、索引逐项保留 JIF Quartile。AIS Quartile 是另一指标，不作为 JCR-JIF 分区。收录是该版快照，不保证实时状态。

cas.provider: 西北农林科技大学风景园林艺术学院公开附件
cas.note: 高校公开历史参考表，只有刊名、分区、TOP 三列；没有 ISSN，也没有注明大类/小类，故只进行唯一规范化刊名匹配，不宣称具备大类或小类分区。2026 年起原中科院分区停止更新。

doajSnapshot.name: DOAJ public journal metadata enrichment
doajSnapshot.attribution: Journal-level metadata from the Directory of Open Access Journals (DOAJ), public CSV snapshot 2026-09-20, accessed 2026-10-21. Normalized for display; record links and update dates retained.
doajSnapshot.licenseNote: DOAJ current terms explicitly license journal-level metadata under CC0. The historical 2020 announcement describing CC BY-SA 4.0 is superseded by these current terms. The generic website-content license is separate from the journal-metadata license.

fieldDefinitions.source: All normalized record fields originate from the public DOAJ journal CSV; each record links to its DOAJ page. Linked publisher pages have not been independently fetched for every record.
fieldDefinitions.checkedAt: Date the public DOAJ CSV was fetched and normalized, not the date all publisher policies were individually re-verified.
fieldDefinitions.metadataUpdatedAt: Last updated Date from DOAJ. This is not an observation-period year for acceptance rates, review time, fees, or output.
fieldDefinitions.publicationTime: DOAJ field: Average number of weeks between article submission and publication. This is a publisher-reported average for the entire submission-to-publication process. It is not a first-decision, peer-review, or submission-to-acceptance metric; sampling method and statistical period are unspecified in the CSV.
fieldDefinitions.apc.prices: Amounts and currencies are preserved from DOAJ. Currency entries are not added together or converted. Tax inclusion, current eligibility, article-type variation, and final payable charges are not established by this CSV.
fieldDefinitions.noAuthorFeesDeclared: True only when DOAJ explicitly says No to both APC and Has other fees. This is a metadata declaration, not a guarantee of a zero invoice for every manuscript.
fieldDefinitions.publisherCountry: Country of publisher, not necessarily the editorial office, editorial-board country, or all journal affiliations.
fieldDefinitions.licenses: Journal article/content licenses reported in DOAJ; separate from the CC0 license of this metadata dataset.
fieldDefinitions.review.models: Reported review models, potentially more than one; no inference about acceptance probability is made.
fieldDefinitions.continuedBy: A nonempty value identifies a successor title in the source metadata; listing in this snapshot does not by itself prove the old title currently accepts submissions.
fieldDefinitions.indexing: Presence in this public snapshot establishes a DOAJ record as of the snapshot. It does not establish SCIE, SSCI, ESCI, PubMed, MEDLINE, Scopus, JCR quartiles, or CAS tiers.
fieldDefinitions.articleCounts: DOAJ Number of Article Records is omitted because it is not annual journal publication volume.

warnings: The public snapshot is dated 2026-09-20 and was downloaded 2026-10-21; individual records can be older. Always display source and metadataUpdatedAt when making submission decisions.

Do not overwrite duplicate ISSN keys silently. Two duplicate keys refer to the same title; ISSN 2500-154X appears on two different Russian titles in the source CSV and needs manual resolution before identity-based merging.
DOAJ coverage is open-access journals, not all journals worldwide. Publication-time and fee metadata are publisher declarations, not verified applicant outcomes.

featuredSelection.method: Representative loading preview: field coverage, curated records, documented JIF, and explicit APC metadata <=1000 USD; not a quality ranking or submission recommendation.
featuredSelection.apcCaution: APC values are bibliographic source metadata and may be old; publisher currency, taxes, article type and waivers must be checked. Unknown values are never interpreted as free.

meta.featuredNotice: 当前为快速加载的精选预览；完整目录在后台加载，预览结果不代表全库筛选结果。
